---
title: "Sources"
subtitle: "Cite the original publication and the exact data release for each dataset you use."
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
source(file.path("report", "_setup.R"))
S <- cat_tbl("Studies"); G <- cat_tbl("Ground_data")
```

The catalogue citation does not replace either. [BibTeX](`r gh_blob("references/studies.bib")`) · [catalogue citation](`r gh_blob("CITATION.cff")`) · [licensing status](`r gh_blob("docs/release_licensing.md")`) · [full source notes](`r gh_blob("SOURCES.md")`)

## Studies

```{r}
S |> transmute(Study = study_name, Year = na_dash(publication_year), Target = carbon_pool_or_target, Publication = link_md(paper_url, "Paper")) |> kable()
```

## Ground data providers

```{r}
G |> transmute(Dataset = resource_name, Provider = link_md(source_url, "Source"), Licence = na_dash(licence_note)) |> kable()
```
